assets.creator: VECTOR//NOVA project contributors; original concept generated with built-in imagegen
assets.provenance: Original cylindrical-habitat circuit with winding S-bends, a spatial 360-degree garden corkscrew, wall climb and ceiling inversion, two native open transfers and a target-independent outward flight field. Five planted chicanes and paired launch guides share exact rendered/native faces, local lane bounds and rival previews. The original Blender civic kit retains all-sided full/Far gallery families, planted-roof sockets, footprint bounds, editable source and reproducible export hashes. Authored legacy ground retains seventeen terrace recipes, exact CPU seating heights and route guides. Two separately authored quarters join a lakeside canal/loggia and stepped housing to a contrasting low Waterside market, sunken court, basin, founded paths and stairs. A contour-garden carrier follows exact legacy triangles with smooth exported normals, canonical borrowed terrain material/UVs, a mature crescent grove and seated pavilion arrival; buried foundation geometry remains in editable source. Asset records retain actual face support, route/lake clearance, planting sockets and lifecycle guards. Level-owned reservoirs/quays, connected promenades, viaduct piers, Sunline gates, corkscrew load spines, endcaps and axial sun complete the world. Gardens consume the public Worldkit Living Forest geometry and canonical bark/foliage imagery, including one consumer-owned simplified wood tier. Independently decoded Helion ceramic KTX2 maps borrow the registered CC0 Concrete034 substrate. The original generated concept and exact prompt are retained as reference only and never rendered as scenery.
assets.rights: Original code, authored geometry and Blender models; generated original reference and Worldkit bark/foliage imagery; existing registered CC0-1.0 Concrete034 substrate.

assets.creator: VECTOR//NOVA project contributors and built-in imagegen
assets.provenance: Original 15.0 km downhill race and 600 m runout across eleven colossal wheeled carriers, with about 2.9 kilometres of true descent across five salt shelves and ten physical moving-deck transfers, including four large roof catches. Connected original Blender salt terraces use identical rendered and native faces: an invariant physical floor and risers, plus separate sculpted escarpment brows moving through the convoy reference frame. Two grounded visual companion carriers reuse the same fleet kit without becoming route owners. Editable Blender carrier, wheel and freight meshes retain their builder, named attachment sockets, scalar PBR materials, visual detail tiers and matching collision export. Separate Blender load frames are authored from the exact road guides and seated on the retained hull triangles. A formed receiving cargo crown mounts to Passing Deck and exports the same evaluated geometry for visual rendering and native moving collision. Freight Cathedral adds a roof-seated suspended crane/load train with exact moving collision. Both visual companions reuse fitted service armor with deep cooling recesses and raycast hull sockets. Portside Dive adds a hull-conforming service belt with three unequal returned armor fields, cooling shutters and recessed transmission access; its evaluated faces also supply moving collision. Saltwind alone replaces its body with a locally cloned hull opened around three unequal cooling, maintenance-gallery and radiator bays. The carrier kit retains enlarged round wheels, fitted lower wheel wells and cutback portal fenders; Saltwind reuses these wheel instances and retains matching major hull collision and exact additive service-bay collision. Source/export SHA-256 hashes are retained in the Blender provenance records. Connected carrier work districts consume the public Worldkit industrial kit: gantries, factory bays, transfer beds, hydraulic banks, gearboxes, louvers, cooling banks, drive wheels, service decks and towers. Nomad owns their fitted foundations, load arms, feeds, placement and clearance. Crane Alley adds a connected ceiling-hung Worldkit roller, gearbox, cooler and service bridge; its exact packed rendering faces also supply native moving collision. Canonical generated Worldkit steel/enamel maps supply physical-scale finish attached to the moving carrier or road; local coating and salt wear add restrained variation without new imagery. The original imagegen concept and exact prompt are retained as reference only. A separately generated cloud-only panorama supplies distant sky radiance and reflections; its retained source and runtime PNG are byte-identical. Filtered salt, warm working-steel decks, navigation paint, exact rolling wheels with filtered speed finish, subtle tire contacts, suspended freight, suspended batched approach beacons, continuous tire spray and roughly 750 m salt wakes express the 1,500 km/h convoy through authored geometry or shaders.
assets.rights: Project-authored code, Blender geometry and scalar PBR materials; original generated concept, sky and canonical Worldkit finish imagery. No downloaded third-party models or artwork.

Original Blender anchor fleet and transverse tension galleries retain editable sources, reproducible builders, named sockets and scalar PBR materials. A separately retained Blender ventral service insert adds formed keel coamings, recessed bays, open ribs and seated nozzle cuffs on two prominent carriers, sharing their original materials and existing batches. Small seated underside rim fittings and outboard load arms connect the galleries to the sail edges. Native supports in src/levels/ravel/bearing.js seat one retained fleet spindle at the first roll; src/levels/ravel/track/reinforcement.js supplies original composite weave and formed bond shading without new image assets. An original generated foil height field supplies linear bump relief for irregular strain creases; the retained source and runtime PNGs are byte-identical, with no baked lighting or geometry displacement. Connected machinery borrows the public Worldkit industrial kit and canonical generated steel/enamel finish; reference imagegen concepts are retained separately and never rendered as scenery.
assets.rights: Project-authored code, geometry, Blender meshes and procedural radiance; original generated foil height and Worldkit finish maps. No downloaded third-party models or artwork.

assets.creator: VECTOR//NOVA project contributors with Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX
assets.provenance: Eight local text-to-audio cues: Jump Drive launch and landing catch, Reserve Injector, Slipstream Drive, Deflector and Magnetic Stabilizer activation, plus Lance fire and hull impact. Revised for distinct physical actions and generated sequentially with the pinned official MLX runtime, FP16 Small-SFX and FP32 SAME-S decoder, without reference audio. Stereo 44.1 kHz 16-bit PCM; leading padding removed, source windows cropped to the action with 0.5–1 ms attack and 20–75 ms end fades, and peak normalization. Lance uses a rounded ion-discharge firing cue and compact mini-boom impact. Its current fire cue is a fresh local generation, mastered with a gentle low cut, softened upper frequencies and attack/tail fades by assets/audio/sfx/lance-fire-edit.py; the exact source hash, filter coefficients, processing recipe and final hash are retained in its provenance. Slipstream retains a full four-second rushing body. Exact generation configs, source/final hashes and sample-accurate edits are retained. Lance fire/impact approved by the user; other equipment cues remain integrated for audition. Deflector block/expiry reuse the established shield-block recording.
assets.rights: AI-generated output. Runtime code is MIT; model weights use the Stability AI Community License and the T5Gemma encoder carries Gemma terms. See docs/audio/sfx.md.
